test_title: PYST 60: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The residents of Rameswaram / about the 1940s were quite / orthodox, but were also / tolerant of other communities.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in the phrase "**about the 1940s were quite**."
